method: Inspected all nine iteration-55 pages at original render resolution, including title, equations, geometry and model figures, captions, table, results, discussion, declarations and 18 references. Iteration 56 page 8 was reinspected after the linked-repository label change. All nine iteration-57 page rasters match the directly reviewed iteration-56 rasters byte-for-byte; pages 1-7 and 9 also match iteration 55.

observations.1-3: Abstract discloses high-level classifier gate failure and scope; geometry-axis label fits; generator flow and diagram read clearly.
observations.4-6: Model equations, count mask, cap and response mechanism, paired C2ST caveat, and results table are legible without clipping.
observations.7: Longitudinal plot, hit-count distance and interval, original three-family classifier results and failed gate, zero fraction, and decoder checks render intact.

iteration_findings: Iterations 52-54 passed automated QA but visual review found an orphan bibliography page. Iteration 55 recovered nine pages; iteration 56 repaired an awkward printed URL; iteration 57 passes exact source-bound QA. Seven release-guard tests pass when called via the script entry point. The module-style test invocation failed due its import path and was corrected without changing tests.
